method: min(0.8*solo) = 0.8*3305 = 2644 MiB/s (kvmhost method, no paper-1536 clip: 3*1536=1.39x device parallel headroom gave only 26% contention drop vs kvmhost 48%)

solo_probe.workload: fio 64k randread QD8 direct=1 time_based (preallocated 32G file)
solo_probe.retention: keep forever; this file is the calibration evidence and must NOT be deleted

rate_rule: rate = min(1536, round(0.8 * solo 64KiB/QD8 direct randread MiB/s)); 0.8*solo = 2644 MiB/s -> truncated to the paper cap 1536 MiB/s (same truncation value as the kvmhost pipeline)
io_max_rule: paper 1500/500/500 MiB/s scaled by rate/1536 (cap==paper cap, so unscaled)
device_major_minor_note: obtained at run time by the runner from /sys/block/nvme0n1/dev (bare-metal coreutils stat lacks %H:%L); root fs is /dev/nvme0n1p2 (259:2) on the same queue, verified empirically by the runner's io.max smoke
iocost_model_source: derived_linear_from_solo_64K (kvmhost deviation 2: same-workload-scale linear model from the solo 64K/QD8 probe; 4K-based iocost_coef_gen model is work-conserving for 64K QD8 streams and was not used)
iocost_qos_source: kernel-doc example magnitudes, identical to the kvmhost m2_fig2 pipeline (paper does not publish exact qos parameters)

environment.target_mode: preallocated 32G file + fio direct=1 on root fs (LEDGER decision 1; no mkfs, no raw-device access)

note: parameter-strength variant; rate1536 run archived under runs/m2fig2/m2fig2_bm_20261105
